claim: For the positive-parameter two-parameter Brownian sheet in d=2 or d=3, almost surely every orthogonal line projection of its zero set has Hausdorff dimension 2-d/2; hence no sheet-dependent random exceptional projection exists.
proof_location: LITERATURE.md: exact Theorem 1.2 quotation and line-by-line application; ATTEMPT.md: Complete application proof
remaining_gap: None for the intended source hypotheses. Invokes Chen-Woessner Theorem 1.2 and Proposition 1.1 rather than claiming an independent proof of them.
